original_english: Control and coordination are the functions of the nervous system and hormones in our bodies.
hinglish_roman: Control aur coordination hamare body mein nervous system aur hormones ka kaam hai.

original_english: All information from our environment is detected by the specialised tips of some nerve cells.
hinglish_roman: Hamare environment ki saari information kuch special nerve cells ke tips se detect hoti hai.

original_english: Receptors are usually located in our sense organs such as the inner ear, the nose, and the tongue.
hinglish_roman: Receptors aamtaur par hamare sense organs mein hote hain jaise inner ear, naak aur jeebh.

original_english: Gustatory receptors will detect taste while olfactory receptors will detect smell.
hinglish_roman: Gustatory receptors taste detect karte hain jabki olfactory receptors smell detect karte hain.

original_english: Information acquired at the dendritic tip sets off a chemical reaction that creates an electrical impulse.
hinglish_roman: Dendritic tip par mili information ek chemical reaction shuru karti hai jo electrical impulse create karta hai.

original_english: The electrical impulse travels from the dendrite to the cell body and then along the axon to its end.
hinglish_roman: Electrical impulse dendrite se cell body tak aur phir axon ke saath uske end tak travel karta hai.

original_english: At the end of the axon, the electrical impulse sets off the release of some chemicals.
hinglish_roman: Axon ke end par, electrical impulse kuch chemicals release karta hai.

original_english: These chemicals cross the gap or synapse and start a similar electrical impulse in the next neuron.
hinglish_roman: Yeh chemicals gap ya synapse cross karke agle neuron mein ek similar electrical impulse shuru karte hain.

original_english: Nervous tissue is made up of an organised network of nerve cells or neurons.
hinglish_roman: Nervous tissue nerve cells ya neurons ke ek organised network se bana hota hai.

original_english: A reflex is a sudden action in response to something in the environment without thinking about it.
hinglish_roman: Reflex ek aisi sudden action hai jo environment mein kisi cheez ke response mein bina soche hoti hai.

original_english: Touching a flame is an urgent and dangerous situation that requires a quick reflex response.
hinglish_roman: Aag ko chhoona ek urgent aur dangerous situation hai jisme quick reflex response chahiye.

original_english: A reflex arc is a connection between the input nerve and the output nerve made in the spinal cord.
hinglish_roman: Reflex arc spinal cord mein input nerve aur output nerve ke beech ek connection hota hai.

original_english: Nerves from all over the body meet in a bundle in the spinal cord on their way to the brain.
hinglish_roman: Poore body se nerves ek bundle mein spinal cord mein milti hain jab woh brain ki taraf jaati hain.

original_english: Reflex arcs are formed in the spinal cord itself although the information also goes on to reach the brain.
hinglish_roman: Reflex arcs spinal cord mein hi form hote hain lekin information brain tak bhi pahunchti hai.

original_english: The brain and spinal cord together constitute the central nervous system.
hinglish_roman: Brain aur spinal cord milkar central nervous system banate hain.

original_english: The brain has three major parts: the fore-brain, mid-brain and hind-brain.
hinglish_roman: Brain ke teen major parts hain: fore-brain, mid-brain aur hind-brain.

original_english: The fore-brain is the main thinking part of the brain with regions that receive sensory impulses.
hinglish_roman: Fore-brain brain ka main thinking part hai jisme sensory impulses receive karne ke regions hote hain.

original_english: Separate areas of the fore-brain are specialised for hearing, smell, sight and so on.
hinglish_roman: Fore-brain ke alag-alag areas hearing, smell, sight aur baaki cheezein ke liye specialised hote hain.

original_english: Many involuntary actions are controlled by the mid-brain and hind-brain.
hinglish_roman: Bahut saari involuntary actions mid-brain aur hind-brain ke dwara control hoti hain.

original_english: Involuntary actions including blood pressure, salivation and vomiting are controlled by the medulla in the hind-brain.
hinglish_roman: Blood pressure, salivation aur vomiting jaise involuntary actions hind-brain ke medulla se control hote hain.

original_english: The cerebellum is responsible for precision of voluntary actions and maintaining the posture and balance of the body.
hinglish_roman: Cerebellum voluntary actions ki precision aur body ka posture aur balance maintain karne ke liye responsible hai.

original_english: The brain sits inside a bony box and is surrounded by a fluid-filled balloon for shock absorption.
hinglish_roman: Brain ek bony box ke andar hota hai aur shock absorption ke liye fluid-filled balloon se ghira hota hai.

original_english: The vertebral column or backbone protects the spinal cord.
hinglish_roman: Vertebral column ya backbone spinal cord ki raksha karta hai.

original_english: Muscle cells have special proteins that change their shape and arrangement in response to nervous electrical impulses.
hinglish_roman: Muscle cells mein special proteins hote hain jo nervous electrical impulses ke response mein apni shape aur arrangement change karte hain.

original_english: Plants also use electrical-chemical means to convey information from cell to cell.
hinglish_roman: Plants bhi ek cell se doosre cell tak information pahunchane ke liye electrical-chemical tarike use karte hain.

original_english: Plants show two different types of movement: one dependent on growth and the other independent of growth.
hinglish_roman: Plants do alag tarah ki movement dikhate hain: ek growth par dependent aur doosri growth se independent.

original_english: The leaves of the sensitive plant move very quickly in response to touch without any growth.
hinglish_roman: Sensitive plant ki pattiyan bina kisi growth ke touch ke response mein bahut jaldi hilti hain.

original_english: Plant cells change shape by changing the amount of water in them, resulting in swelling or shrinking.
hinglish_roman: Plant cells mein paani ki maatra badalne se unka shape change hota hai, jiske wajah se woh phoolte ya sikudte hain.

original_english: Environmental triggers such as light or gravity change the directions that plant parts grow in.
hinglish_roman: Light ya gravity jaise environmental triggers plant ke parts ki growth ki direction change karte hain.

original_english: In phototropic movement, shoots respond by bending towards light while roots respond by bending away from it.
hinglish_roman: Phototropic movement mein shoots light ki taraf jhuk jaate hain jabki roots usse door jhuk jaati hain.

original_english: Geotropism is the upward and downward growth of shoots and roots respectively in response to gravity.
hinglish_roman: Geotropism gravity ke response mein shoots ka upar aur roots ka neeche growth hai.

original_english: Chemotropism is the growth of pollen tubes towards ovules.
hinglish_roman: Chemotropism pollen tubes ka ovules ki taraf growth hai.

original_english: Electrical impulses are an excellent means for fast information transfer but can only reach cells connected by nervous tissue.
hinglish_roman: Electrical impulses fast information transfer ke liye bahut achha tarika hai lekin yeh sirf nervous tissue se connected cells tak pahunch sakta hai.

original_english: Hormones are chemicals used by multicellular organisms for control and coordination.
hinglish_roman: Hormones woh chemicals hain jo multicellular organisms control aur coordination ke liye use karte hain.

original_english: Different plant hormones help to coordinate growth, development and responses to the environment.
hinglish_roman: Alag-alag plant hormones growth, development aur environment ke response ko coordinate karne mein madad karte hain.

original_english: Auxin is a hormone synthesised at the shoot tip that helps the cells to grow longer.
hinglish_roman: Auxin ek hormone hai jo shoot tip par banta hai aur cells ko lamba hone mein madad karta hai.

original_english: When light comes from one side, auxin diffuses towards the shady side of the shoot causing it to bend towards light.
hinglish_roman: Jab ek taraf se light aati hai, auxin shoot ke chhaon wale side ki taraf diffuse hota hai aur shoot light ki taraf jhuk jaata hai.

original_english: Gibberellins help in the growth of the stem similar to auxins.
hinglish_roman: Gibberellins auxins ki tarah stem ki growth mein madad karte hain.

original_english: Cytokinins promote cell division and are present in greater concentration in fruits and seeds.
hinglish_roman: Cytokinins cell division badhate hain aur fruits aur seeds mein zyada concentration mein hote hain.

original_english: Abscisic acid is a plant hormone that inhibits growth and causes wilting of leaves.
hinglish_roman: Abscisic acid ek plant hormone hai jo growth rok deta hai aur pattiyon ko murjha deta hai.

original_english: Adrenaline is a hormone secreted from the adrenal glands directly into the blood.
hinglish_roman: Adrenaline ek hormone hai jo adrenal glands se seedha khoon mein secrete hota hai.

original_english: Adrenaline causes the heart to beat faster resulting in supply of more oxygen to muscles.
hinglish_roman: Adrenaline ki wajah se dil tez dhadakta hai jisse muscles ko zyada oxygen milti hai.

original_english: Blood to the digestive system and skin is reduced due to contraction of muscles around small arteries.
hinglish_roman: Chhoti arteries ke aas-paas muscles ke sikudne se digestive system aur skin mein khoon ka flow kam ho jaata hai.

original_english: The breathing rate also increases because of the contractions of the diaphragm and the rib muscles.
hinglish_roman: Diaphragm aur rib muscles ke sikudne ki wajah se saans lene ki dhar bhi tej ho jaati hai.

original_english: The endocrine system constitutes a second way of control and coordination in our body.
hinglish_roman: Endocrine system hamare body mein control aur coordination ka doosra tarika hai.

original_english: Iodine is necessary for the thyroid gland to make thyroxin hormone.
hinglish_roman: Thyroid gland ko thyroxin hormone banane ke liye iodine zaroori hai.

original_english: Thyroxin regulates carbohydrate, protein and fat metabolism in the body to provide the best balance for growth.
hinglish_roman: Thyroxin body mein carbohydrate, protein aur fat metabolism ko regulate karke growth ke liye best balance deta hai.

original_english: If iodine is deficient in our diet, we might suffer from goitre, a disease causing a swollen neck.
hinglish_roman: Agar hamare khane mein iodine ki kami ho, toh hum goitre se pareshan ho sakte hain jisme gala sooj jaata hai.

original_english: Growth hormone is secreted by the pituitary gland and regulates growth and development of the body.
hinglish_roman: Growth hormone pituitary gland se secrete hota hai aur body ke growth aur development ko regulate karta hai.

original_english: If there is a deficiency of growth hormone in childhood it leads to dwarfism.
hinglish_roman: Agar bachpan mein growth hormone ki kami ho, toh dwarfism ho sakta hai.

original_english: Changes associated with puberty are because of the secretion of testosterone in males and oestrogen in females.
hinglish_roman: Puberty ke saath hone wale changes ladkon mein testosterone aur ladkiyon mein oestrogen ke secretion ki wajah se hote hain.

original_english: Insulin is a hormone produced by the pancreas that helps in regulating blood sugar levels.
hinglish_roman: Insulin pancreas se banna ek hormone hai jo blood sugar levels ko regulate karne mein madad karta hai.

original_english: If insulin is not secreted in proper amounts, the sugar level in the blood rises causing harmful effects.
hinglish_roman: Agar insulin sahi maatra mein secrete na ho, toh blood mein sugar level badh jaata hai jo haanikaarak hai.

original_english: The timing and amount of hormone released are regulated by feedback mechanisms.
hinglish_roman: Hormone kitni maatra mein aur kab release hoga yeh feedback mechanisms se regulate hota hai.

original_english: If blood sugar levels rise, the pancreas produces more insulin, and as sugar levels fall, insulin secretion is reduced.
hinglish_roman: Jab blood sugar level badhe, pancreas zyada insulin banata hai, aur jab sugar level ghate, insulin secretion kam hoti hai.

original_english: Movement in response to the environment is carefully controlled in living organisms.
hinglish_roman: Jeevit praaniyon mein environment ke response mein movement bahut carefully control hoti hai.

original_english: Specialised tissues are used to provide control and coordination activities in multicellular organisms.
hinglish_roman: Multicellular organisms mein control aur coordination ke liye specialised tissues use hote hain.

original_english: In animals, control and coordination are provided by nervous and muscular tissues.
hinglish_roman: Jaanwaron mein control aur coordination nervous aur muscular tissues se milta hai.

original_english: The communication between the central nervous system and the other parts of the body is facilitated by the peripheral nervous system.
hinglish_roman: Central nervous system aur body ke baaki hisson ke beech communication peripheral nervous system ke zariye hota hai.

original_english: Writing, talking, and moving a chair are examples of voluntary actions based on deciding what to do next.
hinglish_roman: Likhna, bolna aur kursi hilana voluntary actions ke examples hain jo aage kya karna hai, iske faisle par based hain.

original_english: Walking in a straight line, riding a bicycle and picking up a pencil are possible due to the cerebellum.
hinglish_roman: Seedhi line mein chalna, cycle chalana aur pencil uthana cerebellum ki wajah se possible hai.

original_english: Our hearts beat without our thinking about it as an involuntary action.
hinglish_roman: Hamaara dil bina soche ek involuntary action ki tarah dhadakta rehta hai.

original_english: Pea plant tendrils are sensitive to touch and coil around any support they come in contact with.
hinglish_roman: Matar ke plant ki tendrils touch ke liye sensitive hoti hain aur jis bhi support se milti hain uske aas-paas lapet jaati hain.

original_english: The part of the tendril in contact with the object does not grow as rapidly as the part away from the object.
hinglish_roman: Tendril ka jo part object se contact mein hai woh utni tezi se nahi badhta jitna door wala part badhta hai.

original_english: Hormones produced in one part of an organism move to another part to achieve the desired effect.
hinglish_roman: Ek organism ke ek hisse mein bane hormones doosre hisse mein jaake desired effect hasil karte hain.

original_english: A chemical signal released by stimulated cells can diffuse all around and be detected by nearby cells.
hinglish_roman: Stimulated cells se release hua chemical signal aas-paas diffuse hota hai aur nearby cells usse detect kar leti hain.

original_english: The nervous system gets information from our sense organs and acts through our muscles.
hinglish_roman: Nervous system hamare sense organs se information leta hai aur hamare muscles ke zariye kaam karta hai.

original_english: The responses of the nervous system can be classified as reflex action, voluntary action or involuntary action.
hinglish_roman: Nervous system ke responses ko reflex action, voluntary action ya involuntary action mein classify kiya jaata hai.

original_english: Hypothalamus plays an important role in the release of many hormones.
hinglish_roman: Hypothalamus bahut se hormones ke release mein important role play karta hai.

original_english: When the level of growth hormone is low, the hypothalamus releases growth hormone releasing factor.
hinglish_roman: Jab growth hormone ka level kam ho, hypothalamus growth hormone releasing factor release karta hai.

original_english: Plant cells change shape by changing the amount of water in them resulting in swelling or shrinking.
hinglish_roman: Plant cells apne andar paani ki maatra badal kar apni shape change karte hain, jisse woh phoolte ya simatat hain.

original_english: The roots of a plant always grow downwards while the shoots grow upwards in response to gravity.
hinglish_roman: Gravity ke response mein plant ki roots hamesha neeche badhti hain jabki shoots upar badhte hain.

original_english: The thinking tissue in our body consists of dense networks of intricately arranged neurons in the brain.
hinglish_roman: Hamare body mein thinking tissue brain mein bahut ghane aur pechida tarike se arrange neurons ke network se bana hota hai.

original_english: Plants respond to stimuli slowly by growing in a particular direction which appears as movement.
hinglish_roman: Plants dheere-dheere ek specific direction mein growth karke stimuli ka response dete hain jo movement jaisa lagta hai.

original_english: Chemical coordination in plants and animals involves hormones that are synthesised at one place and act at another.
hinglish_roman: Plants aur animals mein chemical coordination mein aise hormones hote hain jo ek jagah banate hain aur doosri jagah kaam karte hain.

original_english: Receptors detect information from the environment through the tips of nerve cells.
hinglish_roman: Receptors nerve cells ke tips ke through environment se information detect karte hain.

original_english: Gustatory receptors detect taste while olfactory receptors detect smell.
hinglish_roman: Gustatory receptors taste detect karte hain jabki olfactory receptors smell detect karte hain.

original_english: An electrical impulse travels from the dendrite to the cell body and then along the axon.
hinglish_roman: Electrical impulse dendrite se cell body tak jaata hai aur phir axon ke along travel karta hai.

original_english: At the synapse, chemicals cross the gap and start a similar impulse in the next neuron.
hinglish_roman: Synapse par chemicals gap cross karte hain aur agle neuron mein similar impulse start karte hain.

original_english: Nervous tissue is made up of an organised network of neurons.
hinglish_roman: Nervous tissue neurons ke ek organised network se bana hota hai.

original_english: A neuromuscular junction allows impulses to pass from neurons to muscle cells.
hinglish_roman: Neuromuscular junction impulses ko neurons se muscle cells tak pass hone deta hai.

original_english: All information from the environment is detected by specialised nerve cell tips. These receptors are located in sense organs like the ear, nose, and tongue.
hinglish_roman: Environment ki saari information specialised nerve cell tips dwara detect hoti hai. These receptors are located in sense organs like the ear, nose, and tongue.

original_english: A chemical reaction at the dendrite creates an electrical impulse. This impulse then travels through the neuron to reach its end.
hinglish_roman: Dendrite par ek chemical reaction electrical impulse create karta hai. This impulse then travels through the neuron to reach its end.

original_english: The synapse is the gap between two neurons. Chemicals released here start a new impulse in the next neuron.
hinglish_roman: Synapse do neurons ke beech ka gap hota hai. Chemicals released here start a new impulse in the next neuron.

original_english: Nervous tissue conducts information as electrical impulses. This is how one part of the body communicates with another.
hinglish_roman: Nervous tissue information ko electrical impulses ke roop mein conduct karta hai. This is how one part of the body communicates with another.

hinglish_roman: Synapse kya hota hai?

original_english: How does a signal travel through a neuron?
hinglish_roman: Neuron mein signal kaise travel karta hai?

original_english: How do receptors help us detect changes in the environment?
hinglish_roman: Receptors humein environment ke changes kaise detect karne mein help karte hain?

original_english: What is a neuromuscular junction?
hinglish_roman: Neuromuscular junction kya hota hai?

original_english: Touching a hot object is an urgent and dangerous situation for the body.
hinglish_roman: Hot object ko touch karna body ke liye ek urgent aur dangerous situation hota hai.

original_english: Reflex arcs are formed in the spinal cord itself.
hinglish_roman: Reflex arcs spinal cord mein hi form hote hain.

original_english: A reflex arc connects the input nerve and the output nerve at the point where they first meet.
hinglish_roman: Reflex arc input nerve aur output nerve ko us point par connect karta hai jahan woh pehli baar milte hain.

original_english: Reflex actions happen quickly because thinking through the brain would take too much time.
hinglish_roman: Reflex actions jaldi hote hain kyunki brain se sochne mein bahut zyada time lagta.

original_english: Many animals with very little neuron network still use reflex arcs to respond quickly.
hinglish_roman: Bahut kam neuron network wale animals bhi reflex arcs use karke jaldi respond karte hain.

original_english: Nerves from all over the body meet in a bundle in the spinal cord. Reflex arcs are formed here, even though information also reaches the brain.
hinglish_roman: Body ke saare nerves spinal cord mein ek bundle mein milte hain. Reflex arcs are formed here, even though information also reaches the brain.

original_english: Pulling our hand back from a flame happens reflexly. We do not consciously think about the pain before moving our hand.
hinglish_roman: Flame se haath peeche khinchna reflexly hota hai. We do not consciously think about the pain before moving our hand.

original_english: Reflex arcs evolved because the brain's thinking process is not fast enough. Even after complex neuron networks developed, reflex arcs remain more efficient for quick responses.
hinglish_roman: Reflex arcs isliye evolve hue kyunki brain ka thinking process itna fast nahi hota. Even after complex neuron networks developed, reflex arcs remain more efficient for quick responses.

original_english: What is a reflex action and what is an example of it?
hinglish_roman: Reflex action kya hoti hai aur uska example kya hai?

original_english: How does a reflex arc work in the spinal cord?
hinglish_roman: Reflex arc spinal cord mein kaise kaam karta hai?

original_english: What is the difference between a reflex action and a voluntary action?
hinglish_roman: Reflex action aur voluntary action mein kya farak hai?

original_english: Why does our hand move back quickly as soon as we touch a hot object?
hinglish_roman: Hume hot object touch karte hi haath jaldi peeche kyun ho jaata hai?

original_english: The fore-brain is the main thinking part of the brain.
hinglish_roman: Fore-brain hi brain ka main thinking part hota hai.

original_english: Separate areas of the fore-brain are specialised for hearing, smell, and sight.
hinglish_roman: Fore-brain ke alag areas hearing, smell aur sight ke liye specialised hote hain.

original_english: The medulla in the hind-brain controls involuntary actions like blood pressure and salivation.
hinglish_roman: Hind-brain ka medulla blood pressure aur salivation jaise involuntary actions ko control karta hai.

original_english: The cerebellum is responsible for maintaining posture and balance of the body.
hinglish_roman: Cerebellum body ki posture aur balance maintain karne ke liye responsible hota hai.

original_english: The brain sits inside a bony box and is protected by a fluid-filled balloon.
hinglish_roman: Brain ek bony box ke andar rehta hai aur fluid-filled balloon se protect hota hai.

original_english: The brain and spinal cord together form the central nervous system. They receive information from all parts of the body and integrate it.
hinglish_roman: Brain aur spinal cord milkar central nervous system banate hain. They receive information from all parts of the body and integrate it.

original_english: The vertebral column protects the spinal cord. It is the hard, bumpy structure we feel down the middle of our back.
hinglish_roman: Vertebral column spinal cord ko protect karta hai. It is the hard, bumpy structure we feel down the middle of our back.

original_english: The hunger centre is located in a separate part of the fore-brain. This is why we feel full after eating enough food.
hinglish_roman: Hunger ka centre fore-brain ke ek alag part mein hota hai. This is why we feel full after eating enough food.

original_english: What function does each part of the brain perform?
hinglish_roman: Brain ke kaunse part mein kya kaam hota hai?

original_english: What is the function of the cerebellum?
hinglish_roman: Cerebellum ka kya kaam hai?

original_english: Which part of the brain controls involuntary actions?
hinglish_roman: Involuntary actions brain ke kis part se control hote hain?

original_english: Auxin is synthesised at the shoot tip and helps cells grow longer.
hinglish_roman: Auxin shoot tip par synthesise hota hai aur cells ko longer grow karne mein help karta hai.

original_english: When light comes from one side, auxin diffuses towards the shady side of the shoot.
hinglish_roman: Jab light ek side se aati hai toh auxin shoot ki shady side ki taraf diffuse ho jaata hai.

original_english: Gibberellins, like auxins, help in the growth of the stem.
hinglish_roman: Gibberellins bhi, auxins ki tarah, stem ke growth mein help karte hain.

original_english: Cytokinins promote cell division and are present in higher concentration in fruits and seeds.
hinglish_roman: Cytokinins cell division promote karte hain aur fruits aur seeds mein zyada concentration mein present hote hain.

original_english: Abscisic acid inhibits growth and causes wilting of leaves.
hinglish_roman: Abscisic acid growth ko inhibit karta hai aur leaves ke wilting ka cause banta hai.

original_english: The sensitive plant folds its leaves quickly in response to touch. This movement does not involve any growth.
hinglish_roman: Sensitive plant touch ke response mein apni leaves ko jaldi fold kar leta hai. This movement does not involve any growth.

original_english: Roots grow downward and shoots grow upward in response to gravity. This directional growth is called geotropism.
hinglish_roman: Roots gravity ke response mein neeche ki taraf grow karte hain aur shoots upar ki taraf. This directional growth is called geotropism.

original_english: Tendrils of the pea plant are sensitive to touch. The side in contact with a support grows slower, causing the tendril to curl around it.
hinglish_roman: Pea plant ke tendrils touch ke prati sensitive hote hain. The side in contact with a support grows slower, causing the tendril to curl around it.

hinglish_roman: Auxin kya hai aur yeh kya kaam karta hai?

original_english: How does phototropism occur in plants?
hinglish_roman: Phototropism plants mein kaise hota hai?

original_english: Give an example of a plant hormone that promotes growth.
hinglish_roman: Ek plant hormone ka example dijiye jo growth ko promote karta hai.

hinglish_roman: Adrenaline adrenal glands se seedha blood mein secrete hota hai.

hinglish_roman: Adrenaline heart rate ko badhata hai taaki muscles ko zyada oxygen mile.

hinglish_roman: Thyroid gland ko thyroxin hormone banane ke liye iodine ki zaroorat hoti hai.

hinglish_roman: Childhood mein growth hormone ki deficiency dwarfism ka cause ban sakti hai.

hinglish_roman: Males mein testosterone aur females mein oestrogen puberty ke dauran changes cause karte hain.

hinglish_roman: Insulin pancreas dwara produce hota hai aur blood sugar levels regulate karne mein help karta hai.

hinglish_roman: Thyroxin body mein carbohydrate, protein aur fat metabolism ko regulate karta hai. A deficiency of iodine can lead to goitre.
topic: Endocrine Glands and Hormones in Humans

hinglish_roman: Adrenaline digestive system aur skin ki taraf blood flow ko kam karta hai. This diverts blood to the skeletal muscles for fighting or running.

hinglish_roman: Growth hormone pituitary gland dwara secrete hota hai. It regulates the growth and development of the body.

hinglish_roman: Kuch logon mein insulin sahi matra mein secrete nahi hota. This causes the sugar level in their blood to rise, leading to diabetes.

hinglish_roman: Adrenaline hamare body mein kya changes karta hai?

hinglish_roman: Iodised salt khana kyun zaroori hai?

hinglish_roman: Insulin kya kaam karta hai body mein?

hinglish_roman: Diabetes ke patients ko insulin injections kyun di jaati hain?
topic: Endocrine Glands and Hormones in Humans

hinglish_roman: Feedback mechanisms hormone release hone ke timing aur amount ko regulate karte hain.

original_english: When blood sugar levels rise, pancreas cells respond by producing more insulin.
hinglish_roman: Jab blood sugar levels badhte hain toh pancreas ki cells zyada insulin produce karke respond karti hain.

original_english: As blood sugar level falls, insulin secretion is reduced.
hinglish_roman: Jaise jaise blood sugar level girta hai, insulin secretion kam ho jaata hai.

original_english: The hypothalamus releases growth hormone releasing factor when growth hormone levels are low.
hinglish_roman: Hypothalamus growth hormone releasing factor release karta hai jab growth hormone ka level kam hota hai.

original_english: This releasing factor stimulates the pituitary gland to release growth hormone.
hinglish_roman: Yeh releasing factor pituitary gland ko growth hormone release karne ke liye stimulate karta hai.

original_english: Precise quantities of hormones are needed, so feedback mechanisms keep hormone levels balanced.
hinglish_roman: Hormones ki precise quantities chahiye hoti hain, isliye feedback mechanisms hormone levels ko balanced rakhte hain.

original_english: Pancreas cells detect changes in blood sugar and adjust insulin production accordingly.
hinglish_roman: Pancreas ki cells blood sugar mein changes detect karti hain aur uske hisaab se insulin production adjust karti hain.

original_english: Feedback loops help the endocrine system respond automatically without conscious control.
hinglish_roman: Feedback loops endocrine system ko bina conscious control ke automatically respond karne mein help karte hain.

original_english: If sugar levels in blood rise, the pancreas responds by producing more insulin. As the blood sugar level falls, insulin secretion decreases again.
hinglish_roman: Agar blood mein sugar levels badhte hain toh pancreas zyada insulin produce karke respond karta hai. As the blood sugar level falls, insulin secretion decreases again.

original_english: Hormones must be secreted in very precise quantities. A feedback mechanism ensures that this timing and amount stay controlled.
hinglish_roman: Hormones ko bahut precise quantities mein secrete hona chahiye. A feedback mechanism ensures that this timing and amount stay controlled.

original_english: The hypothalamus detects low levels of growth hormone. It then releases a factor that stimulates the pituitary gland to release more growth hormone.
hinglish_roman: Hypothalamus growth hormone ke low levels ko detect karta hai. It then releases a factor that stimulates the pituitary gland to release more growth hormone.

original_english: How does the feedback mechanism work to control blood sugar levels?
hinglish_roman: Blood sugar level control karne ke liye feedback mechanism kaise kaam karta hai?

original_english: How does the hypothalamus regulate the release of growth hormone?
hinglish_roman: Hypothalamus growth hormone release ko kaise regulate karta hai?

original_english: Reflex actions are controlled by the spinal cord not the brain.
hinglish_roman: Reflex actions brain se nahi, spinal cord se control hoti hain.
hinglish_with_error: Reflex actions brain se nahi, spinal cord se controls hoti hain.
gec_explanation: In Hindi-English code-mixed sentences, English verbs paired with Hindi auxiliaries like 'hoti hain' should remain in base form. 'controls' is incorrect; the base form 'control' is needed since the auxiliary 'hoti hain' carries the tense and agreement.

original_english: Adrenaline is released when we are in a scary or dangerous situation.
hinglish_roman: Jab hum ek scary ya dangerous situation mein hote hain tab adrenaline release hota hai.
hinglish_with_error: Jab hum ek scary ya dangerous situation mein hoti hain tab adrenaline release hota hai.
gec_explanation: 'Hum' (we) in Hindi is treated as masculine or neutral plural; the correct auxiliary is 'hote hain' not 'hoti hain'. 'Hoti' is the feminine form and is grammatically incorrect when the subject 'hum' is generic or masculine.

original_english: Neurons transmit electrical impulses from one part of the body to another.
hinglish_roman: Neurons electrical impulses ek body part se doosre mein transmit karte hain.
hinglish_with_error: Neurons electrical impulses ek body part se doosre mein transmits karte hain.
gec_explanation: When an English verb is used with Hindi compound verb structure ('karte hain'), the English verb should be in its base/infinitive form. 'Transmits' includes the third-person singular inflection which is redundant and incorrect when followed by 'karte hain' which itself carries subject agreement.

original_english: The pituitary gland secretes growth hormone which regulates body development.
hinglish_roman: Pituitary gland growth hormone secrete karta hai jo body development regulate karta hai.
hinglish_with_error: Pituitary gland growth hormone secrete karti hai jo body development regulate karta hai.
gec_explanation: In Hindi, 'gland' is treated as a masculine noun (or defaults to masculine in code-mixed usage), so the auxiliary should be 'karta hai' (masculine) not 'karti hai' (feminine). Using 'karti' creates a gender agreement error with the subject 'pituitary gland'.

original_english: Auxin hormone helps the shoot to bend towards light by promoting cell elongation.
hinglish_roman: Auxin hormone shoot ko light ki taraf jhukne mein madad karta hai cell elongation promote karke.
hinglish_with_error: Auxin hormone shoot ko light ki taraf jhukne mein madad karta hai cell elongation promotes karke.
gec_explanation: When an English verb precedes the Hindi participial form 'karke' (having done / by doing), it must be in its base form. 'Promotes karke' is incorrect; 'promote karke' is the grammatically correct code-mixed form. Adding the '-s' inflection conflicts with the role of 'karke' which already encodes the verbal meaning.

original_english: What is the difference between a reflex action and walking?
hinglish_roman: Reflex action aur walking mein kya antar hai?

original_english: What happens at the synapse between two neurons?
hinglish_roman: Do neurons ke beech synapse par kya hota hai?

original_english: Which part of the brain maintains posture and equilibrium of the body?
hinglish_roman: Brain ka kaun sa part body ka posture aur equilibrium maintain karta hai?

original_english: How do we detect the smell of an agarbatti?
hinglish_roman: Hum agarbatti ki smell kaise detect karte hain?

original_english: What is the role of the brain in reflex action?
hinglish_roman: Reflex action mein brain ka kya role hota hai?

original_english: What are plant hormones?
hinglish_roman: Plant hormones kya hote hain?

original_english: How is the movement of leaves of the sensitive plant different from the movement of a shoot towards light?
hinglish_roman: Sensitive plant ki pattiyon ki movement aur shoot ki light ki taraf movement mein kya fark hai?

original_english: Give an example of a plant hormone that promotes growth.
hinglish_roman: Ek aisi plant hormone ka example do jo growth promote kare.

original_english: Why is the use of iodised salt advisable?
hinglish_roman: Iodised salt use karna kyun zaroori hai?

original_english: How does our body respond when adrenaline is secreted into the blood?
hinglish_roman: Jab adrenaline khoon mein secrete hota hai toh hamara body kaise respond karta hai?

original_english: Why are some patients of diabetes treated by giving injections of insulin?
hinglish_roman: Kuch diabetes patients ko insulin ke injections kyun diye jaate hain?

original_english: What is the function of receptors in our body?
hinglish_roman: Hamare body mein receptors ka kya kaam hota hai?

original_english: How does phototropism occur in plants?
hinglish_roman: Plants mein phototropism kaise hota hai?

original_english: Compare and contrast nervous and hormonal mechanisms for control and coordination in animals.
hinglish_roman: Animals mein nervous aur hormonal mechanisms ko control aur coordination ke liye compare karo.

original_english: How do auxins promote the growth of a tendril around a support?
hinglish_roman: Auxins kaise tendril ko support ke aas-paas badhne mein help karte hain?
